europe_now.title: France Halts Stun Grenade Use During Student Protests
europe_now.summary: France has suspended the use of stun grenades during nationwide student demonstrations following an incident where a 15-year-old protestor lost a hand. The government is attempting to calm the ongoing public unrest as the prime minister prepares to address the situation.

sources.headline: France suspends stun grenade use at student protests ahead of PM speech
France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests

europe_now.title: Large-Scale Russian Attacks Strike Ukraine
europe_now.summary: Russian forces launched a widespread wave of military strikes against Ukraine, resulting in multiple casualties. Ukrainian leadership strongly condemned the large-scale assaults, which coincided with Vladimir Putin's birthday.

top_stories.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry Awarded Jointly
